title: Austin Infrastructure & Budget Approvals 1909
summary:
• **Street Paving Project**: Council approved $1,257.40 to pave East 6th Street, one of the largest expenditures discussed at the meeting.

• **Labor and Engineering Costs**: Approved $1,000 for extra labor expenses and $200-$250 for additional engineering work, reflecting ongoing city maintenance and development needs.

• **Cemetery Maintenance Funding**: Allocated $250 to pay outstanding bills for the City Cemetery.

• **Tax Assessment Cancellations**: Council cancelled unpaid property tax assessments from 1897-1908 for various companies and institutions, including the YWCA at the University of Texas and local churches, clearing them from city records.
